_source: The server's own answers for the seven engines described by our own files (Kokoro, KittenTTS, Pocket TTS, Qwen3-TTS, Chatterbox, VoxCPM2, Speech recognition), computed from this checkout's code on 2026-10-16 (da25ad3e) by scripts/mock-snapshots.js, the pinned speech runtime taken as installed: /v1/engines/capabilities, /v1/voices (presets), /v1/engines (terms), /v1/effects/catalog. Model languages: what /v1/voices says each model speaks; versions: /v1/voices/{id}/model-version's rows.

pocket.title: Kyutai's terms for Pocket TTS
pocket.text: Prohibited use: Use of our model must comply with all applicable laws and regulations and must not result in, involve, or facilitate any illegal, harmful, deceptive, fraudulent, or unauthorized activity. Prohibited uses include, without limitation, voice impersonation or cloning without explicit and lawful consent; misinformation, disinformation, or deception (including fake news, fraudulent calls, or presenting generated content as genuine recordings of real people or events); and the generation of unlawful, harmful, libelous, abusive, harassing, discriminatory, hateful, or privacy-invasive content. We disclaim all liability for any non-compliant use.

effects.label: Chorus
effects.description: Doubling effect. Two slightly-detuned copies layered for thickness.

effects.label: Gain
effects.description: Linear level adjust in dB. Use negative for cut.

effects.label: Compressor
effects.description: Reduces dynamic range — broadcast / podcast staple.

effects.label: Pitch shift
effects.description: Re-pitch in semitones. Wide ranges introduce artefacts.

effects.label: EQ — Low shelf
effects.description: Boost or cut below cutoff with shelf curve.

effects.label: EQ — Mid peak
effects.description: Boost or cut around centre frequency.

effects.label: EQ — High shelf
effects.description: Boost or cut above cutoff with shelf curve.
